'''Freedon Nadd's short lightsaber''' was a [[Color/Legends|bronze]]-bladed, [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|short lightsaber]] that belonged to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Freedon Nadd]].<ref name="TSL" /> When he constructed the weapon,<ref name="TDSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> Nadd utilized a [[rubat]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] in the blade<ref name="KOTORCGWE4" /> and chose a standard cylindrical and straight [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] style.<ref name="TSL" /> After training with and later killing [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], the [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|Sith lightsaber]] was part of Nadd's personal arsenal when he brought his [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] rule to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. Only someone who had embraced the dark side could [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|wield]] the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="date" /> companions of [[Meetra Surik]] broke into the [[Tomb of Freedon Nadd#Dxun tomb|tomb of Freedon Nadd]] on Onderon's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]], in order to prevent the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from aiding a [[Battle of Onderon (Onderon Civil War)|''coup d'etat'']] on the planet.<ref name="TSL" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The trio claimed the lightsaber from [[Freedon Nadd's sarcophagus|Nadd's sarcophagus]].<ref name="TSL-Prima" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Freedon Nadd's lightsaber was first alluded to in [[2001]]'s ''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''.<ref name="TDSS" /> The weapon later appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', which also expanded on the specific details of the lightsaber. While the weapon is described to be usable only by those who have embraced the dark side, it does not function like this in-game, and can be used by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] party members of any [[The Force/Legends|Force]] alignment. For the sake of completeness, this article assumes that the player picked up the lightsaber from the sarcophagus, although they have the option to choose not to do so.<ref name="TSL" />
